title: v0: use your ChatGPT plan
how: ffmpeg streamed the video from its URL into cutscene's measure (256 px luma, every frame); nothing saved but these numbers and stills in scratch
whyTopTier: A 30 s film with no camera movement at all (still 99%): white cards and small UI panels centred on pure black, separated by empty black frames. The sign-in-with-ChatGPT flow is three windows in three shots, then a credits panel switched to 'Using ChatGPT plan' and a model picker 'Powered by GPT-5.6'.
instrument: 60 fps, 22 shots at a 1.33 s median, no moves: everything is a cut, and empty black frames (0.4–1.1 s) act as rests between beats.

byEye.zoom: panels shown at about a third of frame width, centred; no crops
byEye.cards: 'Already pay for ChatGPT? Use your plan in v0', 'v0 now runs on your ChatGPT plan', 'Use any OpenAI model', 'Try it now at v0.app'; v0 × ChatGPT
byEye.sound: an audio track with rhythmic onsets (not listened to)

classify: Hand-edited feature film in v0's minimal house style: locked frames, small centred panels on black, black rests. Conventions: question card, OAuth flow, a toggle, a model picker, a URL card, a partner lockup.

diagnose.observation: Empty black frames of 0.4–1.1 s sit between beats.
diagnose.principle: Rests: a pause in the rhythm separates ideas the way a dissolve would, without blending them.

diagnose.observation: Panels are a third of the frame wide, centred on black.
diagnose.principle: Isolation by negative space instead of zoom; it trades size for calm.

diagnose.observation: Three windows of the sign-in flow in three shots.
diagnose.principle: Compression: one shot per step makes a multi-window OAuth flow read as one action.
A locked-frame genre: every change is a cut, so nothing competes with the UI's own motion.

teaches.text: A timed black rest (0.4–1.0 s) between beats instead of a transition.
Cut-not-move: hand-edited reels often lock the frame.

critique.like: The black rests make each panel arrive as a separate idea.
critique.wish: At a third of the frame width the panels' text is about 9 px at feed size; negative space costs legibility.
critique.wonder: Could the cut between two reel scenes be a black rest of a set length rather than a dissolve?
